Finance (52.0801) NOT included: IPEDS shows 'Finance, General' with 0 bachelor's completions; finance is a concentration inside the BS in Business Administration. Add it by hand if concentrations should count as majors.
Deadline years inferred (page shows 'November 1' / 'January 1' with no year). Nov 1 2026 is a Sunday; Northeastern has historically kept Nov 1 anyway. Recheck before showing deadlines to users.

notes: CDS C1 (p.11 image): applied 14,444 men + 18,947 women + 4 unknown = 33,395; admitted 1,568 + 2,044 + 0 = 3,612. Third-party summaries quote 33,415 / 3,613; the PDF page values were used.

E1 (p.25): the 2025-26 CDS template has no 'Cooperative education programs' checkbox, so coOp left null. Study abroad offered (E1); no published participation rate found, so studyAbroadRate left null.
I3 page header reads 'Common Data Set 2024-2025' but the body says Fall 2025 term; it is in the 2025-26 PDF and the totals reconcile (sum 1,323).

CDS C21 (2025-26 cycle cross-check): ED I 11/4, ED II 1/6. Admissions site (current) lists ED I Nov 2, 2026; ED II Jan 4, 2027; RD Jan 4, 2027. The deadlines page header still says 'Class of 2029' but the dates are explicitly 2026/2027, so cycle = 2026-27.
rollingAdmission false: admissions site gives fixed notification dates (mid-Dec, early Feb, by April 1).
Retention: College Navigator 95% (CDS B22 also 95%: 1,710/1,796).
College Navigator does not list a bachelor's in Business Administration, Nursing, Communication or Finance at Tufts.

Wellesley is a women's college (C1: 0 male applicants), which matters for who it can be recommended to.

C7 read from PDF page 8 image (X grid): Class rank = Important (2), unlike Tufts/Williams.

H2A row N first-year = 4 / H2 row A first-year = 576 -> 0.0069.
E1: 2025-26 template has no co-op checkbox -> coOp null. Study abroad offered; no participation rate found -> studyAbroadRate null.
Deadlines: admissions page states fall 2027 entry: ED I Nov 1, ED II Jan 5, RD Jan 8 (CDS 2025-26 C21 cross-check: ED 11/1, ED II 1/5).

Majors: College Navigator lists psychology as 'Cognitive Psychology and Psycholinguistics' / 'Research and Experimental Psychology, Other' and economics as 'Econometrics and Quantitative Economics', mapped by meaning to Psychology and Economics. No Business, Engineering, Nursing, Communication or Finance bachelor's listed.

notes: CDS source: the official williams.edu PDF (hub.williams.edu/institutional-research/files/2026/04/Williams-CDS-2025-2026-V2.pdf) returns 403/Cloudflare to scripts, so the archived copy of that official 2025-26 PDF on collegedata.fyi was used; every page is headed 'Common Data Set 2025-2026 / Williams College'.
CDS C1 (p.8 image): applied 7,368 + 7,248 + 904 unknown = 15,520; admitted 628 + 661 + 47 = 1,336.
C7 read from PDF page 9 image (X grid). Standardized test scores 'Considered' with a 'See C8 note' (truly test-optional).
C8A: 'Not required for admission, but considered if submitted' -> testBlind false.
H2A row N first-year = 0 (no non-need institutional aid) -> meritAidPct 0 (real data).
E1: 2025-26 template has no co-op checkbox -> coOp null. Study abroad offered; no participation rate found -> studyAbroadRate null.
College Navigator net price by income: the $0-30k, $30-48k and $48-75k rows show no data, so those fields are null (75-110k = $3,030, 110k+ = $49,594).
College Navigator campus setting is 'Town: Fringe', which the field guide maps to SUBURBAN, although Williamstown reads as a small rural town.

Deadlines: williams.edu admissions pages are behind Cloudflare; read via a browser. The current first-year page lists ED 'Nov. 15' (decision by Dec. 14) and RD 'Jan. 4' (answer April 1) with no year printed. Read during the 2026-27 cycle (Oct 2026), so recorded as 2026-11-15 / 2027-01-04. CDS 2025-26 C21 cross-check: ED 11/15, no ED II, no EA. Re-check if Williams posts year-specific dates.
superscores left null: only third-party sites (PrepScholar etc.) say Williams superscores; the official testing section could not be read.
College Navigator lists no bachelor's in Business, Engineering, Nursing, Communication or Finance at Williams.
